description: This PHP script provides localization functions for the TestLink project, including language loading, string retrieval, and internationalization support. It manages language strings, localization overrides, and formatting for dates and times, as well as retrieving email templates based on locale.

methods.name: lang_get
methods.description: Retrieves a localized string based on user language preferences, with fallback to English if necessary.

methods.name: langGetFormated
methods.description: Retrieves a localized string and inserts a modifier into it.

methods.name: lang_load
methods.description: Loads language strings from files into the global array for a specified language.

methods.name: lang_ensure_loaded
methods.description: Ensures that a language's strings are loaded, loading them if necessary.

methods.name: localize_array
methods.description: Converts an array of string keys into localized strings.

methods.name: init_labels
methods.description: Translates a map of codes to localized labels.

methods.name: localize_date_smarty
methods.description: Formats a date for Smarty templates, localizing according to session locale.

methods.name: localize_timestamp_smarty
methods.description: Formats a timestamp for Smarty templates, localizing according to session locale.

methods.name: localize_dateOrTimeStamp
methods.description: Converts a date or timestamp string into a localized date/time format.

methods.name: localizeTimeStamp
methods.description: Converts a timestamp string into a formatted date/time string.

methods.name: mailBodyGet
methods.description: Retrieves email body templates based on locale.
